frames:
Create NEW transparent raster UI COMPONENT ART for the Civilization Survivor vassal art workbench. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 is the regular Warrior frame look; image 2 the founder Warrior and Scholar material language. Do not output a game screenshot or any text layout.
One square RGBA sprite sheet, approximately 1536x1536, laid out as FOUR SEPARATE OBJECTS in a precise 2x2 GRID with ample transparent gutters; each object completely contained in its own equal quadrant, at least 60px transparent padding on all quadrant edges. All empty background and all portrait apertures must be genuinely TRANSPARENT, no white or checkerboard paint, no portraits inside frames.
TOP LEFT: REGULAR WARRIOR PORTRAIT FRAME. A circular aged-brass metal ring in the same style as the accepted regular selection screenshot, with two discreet crossed swords behind the ring and tiny angular shield fittings. The central round portrait aperture is fully transparent. Brass lit edges, rivets, worn etched metal, hand-painted pixel-detailed dark fantasy, narrow rim, no sun crest on this REGULAR frame. Do not add book motifs.
TOP RIGHT: REGULAR SCHOLAR PORTRAIT FRAME. An arched aged-brass frame, curved top, rectangular lower section, carved scroll curls down each side, a small open book at the foot. Entire large inner arched portrait aperture transparent. Same outer object scale, brass colour, rim thickness and visual weight as the Warrior ring. No crown or sun crest on this regular frame, no sword motifs.
BOTTOM LEFT: A SEPARATE SMALL FOUNDER CREST, an embossed sunburst medallion in weathered brass, radial engraved rays, same material as the references, isolated with no text or frame behind it. It must be detachable so the workbench can place it above EITHER class frame to denote a founder; regular frames do not contain it.
BOTTOM RIGHT: an UNKNOWN FOUNDER PORTRAIT silhouette. One anonymous head-and-shoulders figure in solid near-black ink, no visible face, no identifiable clothing detail, no identifiable class prop; a faint warm charcoal edge separates it from the transparent background. NO QUESTION MARK baked into art, code will overlay a large question mark.
No lettering, no values, no labels, no mockup border, no overlapping objects. Match the reference universe: restrained antique brass, charcoal shadow, subtle engraved details, painterly textured pixels, not clean vectors, not modern metallic 3D chrome, no colourful magic effects. Preserve real alpha for all four isolated objects and hollow frame apertures.
portraits:
Generate NEW PAINTED PORTRAIT ASSETS for the Civilization Survivor vassal art workbench. The supplied image is an ART STYLE REFERENCE, not a screenshot to redraw.
Output one square 2x2 sprite sheet of FOUR distinct FULL-BLEED SQUARE BUST PORTRAITS. Each occupies precisely its own equal quadrant, edge to edge, no padding, no text, no borders, no UI frame, no decorative frame, no badges. All four use the same hand-painted pixel-textured low-resolution dark fantasy style as the supplied portraits: subtle brushwork, sharp readable face planes, muted brass/oxblood/ink-blue palette, dark smoky green-black backdrop, warm candle illumination. Not flat vector, not smooth photorealism, not modern anime. Head in upper central half, shoulders in lower half, no huge empty space above head, faces readable when shrunk.
TOP LEFT: young woman with dark wavy hair, warm olive skin, wearing worn steel shoulder armour and an oxblood mantle, brass clothing clasp; Warrior.
TOP RIGHT: the SAME young woman, same face, skin, age and hair, wearing layered ink-blue Scholar robes with subtle brass embroidery, linen collar, carrying the edge of a worn book at lower chest; Scholar. No armour.
BOTTOM LEFT: young man with dark curly hair and warm dark-brown skin, wearing worn steel shoulder armour and muted ochre cloak; Warrior.
BOTTOM RIGHT: the SAME young man, same face, skin, age and hair, wearing dark teal Scholar robes, embroidered stole and a worn book at lower chest; Scholar. No armour.
Class distinction is clothing and tools; face and identity independent of class. No head crowns, no exaggerated racial or class-specific physical features. Keep all 4 portraits same framing, same lighting, same quality.
